name: pr-tools
description: Pull request review and fix loops inside your Claude Code session.

plugins.name: pr-reviewer
plugins.description: Reviews each pull request push in your session: read-only agents, two against the project's written decisions and guidelines (including ones fetched from other GitHub repositories) and two for bugs, a validator confirms each finding, and a PR comment, inline comments and a pr-reviewer commit status are posted. Hands findings to pr-fixer when installed.

plugins.name: pr-fixer
plugins.description: Fixes pull request review findings from any reviewer: checks each against the code, fixes each confirmed one everywhere it occurs, runs the project's checks and pushes.
